title: Slices garlic thin if I'm slicing only a couple of cloves otherwise the blade clogs; also requires lots of pressure to slice
text: Slices garlic thin if I'm slicing only a couple of cloves otherwise the blade clogs; also requires lots of pressure to slice. I purchased this at a Pampered Chef party because I wanted to replace a sliding garlic slicer and this one appeared to work wonderfully at the party. However, after using this over 5 times, I absolutely hate it. I tried several types of garlic including the hard redneck variety and it slices some of the garlic very thin but if I'm slicing more than two cloves, the garlic clogs the blade at the bottom. In addition it requires brute strength to press the top and bottom together to get this to slice. I thought it was just me, so I had my boyfriend try this and he hates it as well. He said, "where did you get this garlic slicer, it's awful"?

product_metadata.title: Pampered Chef Garlic Slicer
features: Drop in peeled garlic cloves and twist
